arms.name: entry_confirmation
arms.hypothesis: Prior-session trend and breadth confirmation plus 2 ATR chase guard may avoid weak entries; may reduce opportunities.

arms.name: exit_atr
arms.hypothesis: ATR trailing may reduce noise exits; must retain the original maximum loss bound.

arms.name: cost_aware
arms.hypothesis: Require projected net target gain at least twice estimated round-trip fees/tax in addition to existing net RR; this is a research hurdle, not proof of edge.

arms.name: portfolio_research
arms.hypothesis: Existing regime/drawdown/loss-streak brakes may reduce losses without widening any authorized limit.

arms.name: combined_candidate
arms.hypothesis: Fixed combination, no tuning or selection after results; no automatic promotion.

rules: Protocol fixed before executing these cases. No parameter search, excluded tickers or deleted losing experiments.
Identical 100000 cash, five-session decisions, five-minute monitoring, odd-lot limits and 1% trade risk / 25% reserve across arms.
All arms explicitly use minimum fee20, net RR1.2, min net gain60; this prevents the original disabled-risk defaults from creating an unfair comparison.
Original engine arm is not the user's original AI strategy, and not its supplied v0.1.5 baseline.
Public fixed ten-stock daily panel has already been studied and has survivorship/corporate-action/odd-lot-book limitations. Neither period is pristine OOS.
Conservative DAILY execution has no inferred intraday depth. Zero trades or cash preservation is not strategy profitability.
Save every full report and failure. Recompute FIFO statistics and accounting outside each engine.
Do not enable any research setting in live/readonly or call any real broker/model. No strategy is promoted without independent validation.
timestamp_note: Corrected only the initially mistyped future UTC timestamp using the original file mtime; arms, scenarios, dates and parameters are unchanged. First run retains the original bytes/hash in protocol-v1-as-run.json; rerun uses this corrected manifest.
